==== /.src/resultMatchToFromResult.ts (0 errors) ====
    // @effect-v3
    // @effect-diagnostics *:off
    // @effect-diagnostics resultMatchToFromResult:suggestion
    import { Effect, Either, Exit } from "effect"
    
    declare const either: Either.Either<number, Error>
    declare const exit: Exit.Exit<number, Error>
    
    // MUST NOT TRIGGER: the rule only supports Effect v4; v3 has no Result module and Either is out of scope.
    export const eitherMatch = Either.match(either, { onLeft: Effect.fail, onRight: Effect.succeed })
    
    // MUST NOT TRIGGER: the Either guard ternary is out of scope on Effect v3.
    export const eitherTernary = Either.isRight(either) ? Effect.succeed(either.right) : Effect.fail(either.left)
    
    // MUST NOT TRIGGER: Exit.match shares the handler names but is not the Result module.
    export const exitMatch = Exit.match(exit, { onFailure: Effect.failCause, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })
